title: StarsCraft
description: A Minecraft resource pack for the Tempura and Armada
body:
(THIS PACK IS STILL A HEAVY WORK IN PROGRESS thx 4 the patience)

This pack was made for [Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and it needs both [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) to work

Current features include:
- Hakkitos instead of Chickens
- Ruzaders instead of Silverfish
- Cultare instead of Slimes
  - All slime-related items have a blue tint to fit the Cultare (slime balls, slime blocks, sticky pistons)
- Koipanions instead of Cods

Stuff to be added in future versions:
- Koipanions should be Nautilus instead of Cod
  - (nautilus can be tamed and have an actual functionality in comparison to cod) (i cant edit nautilus in blockbench yet so i cant do this rn)
- Axelotls instead of Axolotls
- Magmites instead of Spiders
- Vesties instead of Bats
- Bettellion instead of ???
- Machiroons instead of Foxes
- Sorawrity instead of Armadillos
- Big Bubby instead of Iron Golems
- Poppets instead of Allays 
- Corruptions Beasts instead of Zombies
- Change items related to these mobs to fit their Holostars counterpart
